key_facts: Vision loss in the right eye
Ophthalmoscopic examination revealed severe macular changes

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of vision loss, severe macular changes, and associated edema, along with the spectral-domain optical coherence tomography findings showing persistent central macular thickness and changes in macular edema, are most consistent with Cystoid Macular Edema.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO)
rejected.why: While CRVO can cause macular edema, the provided information does not specifically indicate a central retinal vein occlusion.

rejected.label: Macular Retinal Vein Occlusion
rejected.why: This option is not a standard medical term and does not directly match the patient's presentation.

rejected.label: Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO)
rejected.why: BRVO typically affects a branch of the retinal vein and may not fully explain the severe macular changes and edema described.

rejected.label: Hemiretinal Vein Occlusion (HRVO)
rejected.why: HRVO involves occlusion of the veins draining one half of the retina, which is not directly indicated by the patient's symptoms or findings.
